title: solver
author: JG
description: check if solver can raise full solver error message in exception, in order to alleviate tracing during automated code evaluation in SolveStatic and SolveDynamic
releaseNotes: the exception of a failed SolveDynamic or SolveStatic carries the whole message: SolverError with what the solver reports and the reasons and solutions (showHints=True); an exception from inside the solve keeps its type and gets them as a note
